subject_definitions
<Subject 1> is the blonde woman in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, with long wavy hair, bright coral lipstick, a black turtleneck, black coat, grey scarf, black trousers, and black shoes, holding a white paper coffee cup.
<Subject 2> is the young male cyclist in <Picture 1> and <Picture 3>, with a black bicycle helmet, black zip-up jacket, black trousers, black gloves, and black sneakers, holding a paper coffee cup.
<Subject 3> is the coral lipstick in <Picture 4>, with a silver base and matte coral bullet, providing the signature coral accent color for <Subject 1>'s lips and the coffee cup rim mark.

summary
[keyframe completion + reference generation]

retention_analysis

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved

detailed_description
The video is set in a bright, late-morning downtown crosswalk. Cinematic handheld footage captures high-motion, natural interaction. Visuals prioritize concrete grey, reflective glass, and the contrast of black clothing against the coral accents. The characters remain visually consistent and avoid jitter or bent limbs.
[Shot 1]
At 00:00.000, the camera employs a static shot, using <Picture 1> as the exact starting frame. The camera is positioned eye-level, slightly left of center. The frame focuses on <Subject 1> (S1) and <Subject 2>.
Visuals: In the foreground, <Subject 1> faces the camera with a slight smile, her blonde hair swaying gently. Her coral lipstick is a vivid contrast. In the mid-ground, <Subject 2> rides a black bicycle from the left, his helmet secured and his expression focused.
Action: A strong gust of wind enters from the right. It catches the grey scarf around <Subject 1>'s neck, causing the fabric to flutter rapidly. <Subject 1> quickly reaches up with her left hand to grip the end of the scarf, stabilizing it while continuing to hold the coffee cup in her right hand. <Subject 2> brakes subtly as he passes, leaning slightly against the wind.
Camera: Static with subtle handheld micro-tremors.
Sound: Wind swish, bicycle chain, and distant traffic.
Dialogue: None.

[Shot 2]
At 00:06.000, the camera cuts to a tighter framing, transitioning smoothly from the previous action.
Visuals: <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> are now stationary. <Subject 2> positions his coffee near <Subject 1>'s.
Action: <Subject 2> reaches out with his gloved hand to steady the lid of <Subject 1>'s coffee cup, preventing a spill. As he retracts, a small drop of coral-colored lipstick mark is visible on the cup rim. <Subject 1> looks at the mark, then at <Subject 2>. She raises her right hand and, with a light smile, wipes the tiny coral mark from the rim using her thumb. As she does this, a small "pop" sound is heard from the cup lid.
Camera: A gradual Push In at a slow speed, moving from a medium shot to a medium two-shot to emphasize the interaction.
Sound: Bicycle brake squeak, coffee lid pop, and soft city ambience.
Dialogue:
<Subject 1> (S1): <d>[English] Still here.</d>

overall_soundscape
The ambience consists of continuous late-morning city traffic, the steady wash of crowd noise, and sharp physical sounds like wind gusts, metal-on-metal bicycle squeaks, and the soft click of a coffee lid.
